item.title: Health Risks During Extreme Cold
item.description: Hixson, TN (WDEF)-An excessive cold warning remains in effect across Middle Tennessee through Tuesday, and health experts are urging residents to take extra precautions, especially if they take certain medications. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says drugs such as sedatives and some antidepressants can affect the body’s ability to regulate heat, increasing the risk of hypothermia.
